0022600007.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Nuggets visit Oklahoma City, and Denver will be without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) while Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision. The Thunder are missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery). In the 2025-26 season series, the Nuggets lost 1-3, and their most recent meeting came on April 10, 2026, in Denver, when they won 127-107.
